title: openOODA Language Server
content:
## What it is

`ooda-lsp` is the Language Server Protocol (LSP) implementation for openOODA. It speaks LSP 3.17 over stdio (JSON-RPC 2.0 framed) and provides editor-state-driven features: completion, hover, definition, references, rename, formatting, code actions, document symbols, inlay hints, and more.

## Install

The LSP server ships as part of the ooda toolchain. Once `ooda` is on PATH, you have `ooda lsp`.

## Surface

16 methods (4 lifecycle + 11 document + 1 workspace):

| Tier | Methods |
|------|---------|
| Lifecycle | `initialize`, `initialized`, `shutdown`, `exit` |
| Document | `textDocument/didOpen`, `didChange`, `completion`, `hover`, `definition`, `formatting`, `documentSymbol`, `codeAction`, `diagnostic`, `documentLink`, `inlayHint` |
| Workspace | `workspace/executeCommand` |
| Server-to-client | `textDocument/publishDiagnostics` |

Server advertises in `initialize` response: `completionProvider`, `hoverProvider`, `definitionProvider`, `referencesProvider`, `renameProvider`, `documentFormattingProvider`, `documentSymbolProvider`, `codeActionProvider`, `documentLinkProvider`, `inlayHintProvider`, `workspace.executeCommandProvider`. The server does **not** support `textDocument/didClose` (deliberate gap; the dispatcher has no `didClose` branch).

Editor wiring: VS Code (`opencode.json` + `ooda.lsp.path`), Neovim (`lspconfig`), Helix (`languages.toml`), Emacs (`lsp-mode`), Vim (`vim-lsp`).

## Version contract

```
lsp=0.5.0
oooda=2.10.0
ooda_max=2.99.0
oodac=2.10.0
std=2.10.0
api_surface=7
```

See `openOODA/lsp/docs/` for the full reference: `LSP_SETUP.oot`, `protocol.oot`, `client_config.oot`, `CAPABILITIES.oot`.
